verbetes.glosa_atual: ,; incomodar, agitar, manter comoção.; banir, expulsar.; ser banido.
definicoes_originais: to trouble, stir up, keep in commotion.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 168 b הוו קא טַרְדֵּי ליה they were troubling him (begging persistently).—Part. pass. טָרִיד, f. טְרִידָא; pl. טְרִידִין, טְרִידָן. Targ. Is. LVII, 20 (h. text נגרש). Targ. Nah. II, 5 ברקין ט', v. preced.—Ber. 16 b הכא ט' in the one case his mind is preoccupied. Erub. 68 a טְרִידְנָא בגירסאי I am engrossed in my studies. Snh. 108 b [read:] דהות טריד (or דטְרִידַת; Ms. F., טְרִיחַת, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 9) that thou wert troubled (in my behalf); Yalk. Job 917 [read:] חמית דטרידת וכ'; a. fr.
Targ. Y. Gen. III, 24; a. fr.—
. Targ. Prov. XXV, 5. Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 45; a. e.
Ber. 35 b; Yalk. Deut. 863 דלא תִיטַּרְדּוּ וכ' that you may not be troubled about support &c.
Arakh. 16 b אתי לאִיטְּרוּדֵי he may get into a quarrel.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טרק a. נְטַר) proteger, trancar, trancar.; para ser bloqueado.
definicoes_originais: (cmp. טרק a. נְטַר) to guard, lock up, bolt.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XIX, 6 Ar. a. Levita (ed. אחד). Targ. Y. Ex. XIV, 3; a. e.—Lam. R. to I, 1 ט' תרעא (חד מירו') רבתי locked the door. Ib. to I, 18 טְרוֹדוּ תרעין shut the doors closely.—Y. Keth. VII, 31 c תרעה טָרִיד if her door is found locked, contrad. to מוגף, v. גּוּף I.
Targ. Y. II Gen. XLIX, 1.
Ber. 16 b אי משום ט' if anxiety be a cause for omitting to pray. Ib. ט' דרשות anxiety about a secular affair, ט' דמצוה about a religious matter; Succ. 25 a
, v. טַרְטֵימַר

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טרז = טרד I, cmp. טרוזא P. Sm. 151; [úmido, fresco,] uma espécie de pepino ou melão consumido para fins medicinais.

[ moist, cool,] a kind of cucumber or melon eaten for medicinal purposes.
notas_originais: Sabb. 109 a (Ar. טרי', ed. Sonc. טריד).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cmp. טָרַד) turvo, pingando e escuro; [outros; (v. טִרְטֵט) linha reta, terminando abruptamente, v.
definicoes_originais: (v. טִרְטֵט) straight-lined, abruptly ending, v. תָּרוּט.
notas_originais: opin. half-closed; Rashi: round.]— Pl. טְרוּטוֹת. Tosef. Bekh. V, 3 עיניו ט' Var. (ed. Zuck. ת'); Bekh. 44 a (expl. הצִירָן, cmp. Targ. Y. I Gen. XXIX, 17) עיניו ט' Ar. (ed. ת'). Taan. 24 a עיניה ט', opp. יפות. Sabb. 31 a ת'. Snh. 107 b (in a passage omitted in later eds.) עיניה ט'.
, v. טְרוֹקְסִימוֹן

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τρῆμα, ατος, τρημάτιον) perfuração, também buraco de agulha; somente em (בֵּיצָה) בֵּיצַת ט' um ovo fervido até o tamanho de uma pílula que, ao ser engolido pelo paciente, passa pelo corpo inalterado, trazendo consigo matéria que serve ao médico para diagnóstico.
definicoes_originais: (τρῆμα, ατος, τρημάτιον) perforation, also eye of a needle; only in (בֵּיצָה) בֵּיצַת ט' an egg boiled down to the size of a pill which, on being swallowed by the patient, passes the body unchanged, carrying with it matter which serves the physician for diagnosis.
notas_originais: Ned. VI, 1 ביצת טרמיטא Mish. (Bab. ed. ביצה טורמוט'; Y. ed. טרמיטן); ib. 50 a ביצה טורמיטא; Y. ib. VI, 39 c bot. ביצה טרומיטא, expl. רופיטון.

verbetes.glosa_atual: adv. (נְטַר) esperando, cuidando dos negócios, ocioso.
definicoes_originais: adv. (נְטַר) waiting, looking out for business, idle.
notas_originais: Lam. R. introd. (R. Isaac 3) קאים ט' וכ' one stands idly waiting a whole day and is not tired, but for prayer one is tired; (Yalk. Is. 318 קאי וטרי; Esth. R. to I, 9 יתיב ומשתעי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (uma contradição de טרי אנא, v. טְרִי) Eu jogo.
definicoes_originais: (a contr. of טרי אנא, v. טְרִי) I throw.
notas_originais: Lam. R. to II, 1 הא לכון ט' באפיכון here, you have it, I throw it in your face.
, v. טִיר'
, v. תְּרוֹנוֹס

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de טָרָף) coberto com folhas.; (parte. passagem. de טָרַף, cmp. Pi.) desfigurado por manchas irregulares; (outro. opin.) picado, cheio de incisões; (outro. opin.) aplainado, liso.
definicoes_originais: (part. pass. of טָרַף, cmp. Pi.) disfigured by irregular spots; (oth. opin.) chopped, full of incisions; (oth. opin.) planed, smooth.
notas_originais: Tosef. Neg. VIII, 2, v. טֶרֶף.

Ned. 25 a; Shebu. 29 b (ref. to one swearing that he had seen a serpent ‘like the beam of an oil press’) בט' he meant ‘spotted’ like a beam &c. Ib. (in answer to the argument כולהו נחשי מיטרף טריפין (or טריפי, not טרפי) that all serpents are ‘spotted’) בשגבו ט' (Ms. M. שבגבו) he meant a serpent spotted on the back (and not only around the neck). Ned. l. c. קורת … גבו ט' (read גבה) the back of a press beam may be spotted (i.e. no objection of the purchaser is valid based on the spotted condition of the beam); according to the opinion: ט' = planed, all beams must be planed, (otherwise the purchaser has a right to reject).—[Other meanings, v. טָרַף.]
, v. טֵירוּף

verbetes.glosa_atual: , pl. טְרוֹפָאֵי (denominação de טְרֵפָה); aqueles que decidem sobre defeitos de animais para fins rituais, supervisores de carne.; aqueles que decidiram a favor da t’refah, Ib.
definicoes_originais: those deciding on defects of animals for ritual purposes, meat-supervisors.
those who decided in favor of t’refah, Ib.
notas_originais: Ḥull. 55 b
48 b. Ib. 49 a שקילו … דט' seize the cloak of those who decided &c. (make them pay damages).
, Targ. Ps. I, 3 some ed., v. טְיָפָא
, Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 1, לעסק ט', v. טִירוֹן I

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τρωκτή, sub. σταφυλή) uvas de sobremesa, sem produzir vinho.
definicoes_originais: (τρωκτή, sub. σταφυλή) dessert grapes, yielding no wine.
notas_originais: Yalk. Num. 709 טריק' (corr. acc.)—Trnsf. a woman that has no menstruation. Y. Keth. I, 25 a bot.; Nidd. IX, 11 Var. in Hai Gaon, v. דּוֹרְקְטִי.
, Yoma 10 a Ms. M., v. תרייקי

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Targ. Sal. XXXV, 3 ed. Atraso. um. outro., para h. texto סְגרֹ, leia: טְרוֹק יָתִי וזמן וכ' guarde-me e encontre-se etc. [Ed. Bem. um. outro. apenas טרוק.]
notas_originais: , Targ. Ps. XXXV, 3 ed. Lag. a. oth., for h. text סְגרֹ, read: טְרוֹק יָתִי וזמן וכ' guard me, and meet &c. [Ed. Bxt. a. oth. only טרוק.]
, Ber. 37 b, v. טְרִיקְטָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τρώξιμον, τὰ τρώξιμα); tudo o que pode ser comido cru, aplicado em vegetais de cozinha, esp. endívia & c. Lev. R.s. 3 אגודה אחת של טרוקסימא (algumas ed.… מון) um monte de vegetais.; (sub. κῆπος) horta.
definicoes_originais: whatever can be eaten raw, applied to kitchen vegetables, esp. endive &c. Lev. R. s. 3 אגודה אחת של טרוקסימא (some ed. … מון) a bunch of vegetables.
notas_originais: Y. Pes. IV, 31 b, sq. Y. Sabb. VII, 10 a טריקס' ed. Krot. (corr. acc.).—Y. Pes. II, 29 c top (expl. עולשין); Y. Kil. I, 27 a top (some ed. מין …, pl.)—Tosef. Ter. IV, 5 טרקסמן ed. Zuck. (Var. טְרָכְסְמִין, pl.) Tosef. Makhsh. III, 10 טרכ', contrad. to יֶרֶק.

Ber. 35 b היו … דרך ט' וכ' (Ms. M. טרסק'; Ms. F. טריבסמון, corr. acc.) used to bring their fruits home (from the field to the barn) by the way of the kitchen-garden (in sight of the house) in order to make them subject to tithes; Gitt. 81 a; Yalk. Deut. 938.
, v. טָרִיז
, v. טוּרְ'

verbetes.glosa_atual: correr, estar ocupado, esforçar-se, preparar-se.; colocar problemas, atribuir uma tarefa.; cansar.; para incomodar, implore persistentemente.
definicoes_originais: to run about, be busy, to take pains, prepare.
to put to trouble, put a task on.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 3 a מי שט' וכ' he who has made preparations on Friday has food for the Sabbath (he who does good in this world can expect reward in the hereafter). Keth. 10 a; Kidd. 45 b חזקה אין … טוֹרֵחַ וכ' the presumption is that one will not go to the trouble of preparing a (wedding) feast and let it go to ruin, i.e. one must have weighty reasons for a divorce immediately after marriage; Yeb. 107 a. Ber. 58 a, v. טוֹרַח; a. fr.—[Y. M. Kat. I, 80 a bot. דבר שאינו ט', v. טָרֵיחַ.]

Taan. 24 a אתה הִטְרַחְתָּ וכ' thou hast put thy Creator to the trouble of &c. Snh. 8 a מַטְרִיחִין אותי they (the wicked) put me to &c. Lev. R. s. 27 לא הִטְרַחְתִּי עליכם I did not tax you too heavily; a. fr.
Snh. 22 b; Erub. 64 b, a. e., v. טָרַד.
Yalk. Ex. 244 ה' עליו he begged him instantly.

verbetes.glosa_atual: preparar-se para movimentação, carregar (cmp. טָעַן II) Targ. Jó XXXVII, 11 (h. texto יטריח).; incomodar.; implorar persistentemente.; estar cansado.
definicoes_originais: to make ready for moving, to load (cmp. טָעַן II) Targ. Job XXXVII, 11 (h. text יטריח).
notas_originais: Targ. Koh. II, 11. Ib. IX, 9; a. fr.—B. Kam. 11 a בדנפשיה ט' he takes pains with what belongs to himself (for his own benefit). Ḥull. 83 a דאורח ארעא למִטְרַח וכ' in the bridegroom’s family they generally take more trouble in preparing the wedding feast &c.; a. fr. [Sot. 7 b ומטרח, v. טְרִי.]— Part. pass. טָרִיחַ, f. טְרִיחָא giving trouble, troublesome. Ned. 25 a מילתא דלא ט' an easily intelligible expression. Ḥull. 51 a, a next w.—B. Mets. 112 b ט' להו מילתא (Ms. M. ליה) it is too troublesome for them (for him); a. e.—[Sabb. 82 a, v. טְחַר.]—B. Kam. 80 b Ar., v. תְּרַח.
Meg. 22 b לא מַטְרַח ציבורא Ms. M. (ed. לא בעי למִיטְרַח, read למַטְרַח, v. Rashi, a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he would not trouble the congregation (to rise before him); Yalk. Lev. 669; a. fr.
Lev. R. s. 16 א' עליה he insisted upon his telling him.—Y. Peah I, 16 b bot. אין מַטְרְחַת עלוי if you strain the chord too much.
Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 2 אִיטְרְחָא (not אַט').
Taan. 24 b מי איכא דמִיטְּרַה וכ' is it so hard a labor to the Lord?
, v. טוֹרַח
Ḥull. 51 a ט' טְרִיחַ לההוא גברא what trouble has been taken by that man (myself)!—[Oth. version: ט' טַרְיֵיה וכ' weariness (of travel) made me shaky.]
, v. טוּרְחָא

Tem. 24 a דקא טרח טי' וכ' because he would undertake a labor unfit for him (on the Holy Day). B. Mets. 93 b לט' יתירתא with reference to special painstaking. Shebu. 45 a bot. טי' ליה מלתא, v. טְרַח I. M. Kat. 13 a מועד משום ט' ולא ט' Ms. M. (ed. only משום ט') in the festive week it is forbidden only for being a labor to some extent; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: 1) o mesmo.; mesmo. Y. Ber. II, 5 um bot. טַרְחוּתָם מרובה o problema de descê-los é muito grande.; necessidades da vida, viver.
definicoes_originais: same. Y. Ber. II, 5 a bot. טַרְחוּתָם מרובה the trouble of climbing them down is very great.
notas_originais: f.

Pesik. Bayom, p. 193 a ט' הדרכים the trouble of travelling. Cant. R. to VIII, 6 שהגשמים … סימן טיר' for there are those rains which betoken trouble &c.—Pesik. Shek. p. 20 b; Pesik. R. s. 16 end; Ex. R. s. 34 אין הק"בה בא בט' וכ' the Lord comes not with burdensome laws to be imposed upon &c.

Lev. R. s. 1 משה עסוק בט' וכ' Moses occupied himself with arranging the living of Israel (ordaining dietary laws). Gen. R. s. 94 ט' נפש אחת provision for one soul. Pesik. R. s. 3 (ref. to מתה עלי, Gen. XLVIII, 7) עלי היתה טַרְחוּתָהּ mine was the care for her.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Koh. II, 10; um. e.-Sabb. 10 a טריח' למיסר וכ' (Ar. כְּרִיהוּתָא) é tão problemático amarrar um cinto? Hadod. pág. 50 a, a. e. עיקר ט' מטרא o verdadeiro desconforto do inverno é a chuva; um. e.
notas_originais: Targ. Koh. II, 10; a. e.—Sabb. 10 a טריח' למיסר וכ' (Ar. כְּרִיהוּתָא) is it such a trouble to tie on a belt?—Pesik. Haḥod. p. 50 a, a. e. עיקר ט' מטרא the real discomfort of the winter season is the rain; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Lev. R.s. 7 ר' יוסי בן ט', leia-se como Yalk. Sal. 766: פִּיטְרָס.
notas_originais: , Lev. R. s. 7 ר' יוסי בן ט', read, as Yalk. Ps. 766: פִּיטְרָס.
, v. טִיטַרְטוֹן, a. טְרָטִין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טרט = רטרט, cmp. גִּעֲגֵעַ; v. טָרוּט; trançar tiras, amarrar.
notas_originais: Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 1 משיְטַרְטֵט ed. Zuck. (Var. משיְרַטֵּט) until the leather for the strap-mattress is plaited; (cmp. Kel. XVI, 4).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (cacophem. perversões de תִּיאַטְרָאוֹת; cmp. significados de טרט em טָרוּט, טִרְטֵט, a. de טרי, a. perversões semelhantes em אִצְטַדְיָא &c.) teatros, shows.
definicoes_originais: (cacophem. perversions of תִּיאַטְרָאוֹת; cmp. meanings of טרט in טָרוּט, טִרְטֵט, a. of טרי, a. similar perversions in אִצְטַדְיָא &c.) theatres, shows.
notas_originais: Lam. R. to III, 5 ומכניסין את הגמל לבתי ט' they bring a camel on their stage (ib. also תַּרְטְיָאוֹת a. תִּיאַטְרוֹן). Yalk. II Sam. 158; Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII טַרְטִירָאוֹת (ed. Bub. טרטיא'). Keth. 5 a; Sabb. 150 a (Ms. O. טַרְטַסְיָי', early eds. טַרְטְרָאוֹת); a. e. [Various forms in eds. a. Mss.: טַרְטִיסָאוֹת, טַרְטִיּוֹת &c.]—[Ab. Zar. 42 a דרכים וט' ed., Ms. M. סרטיאות, v. סְרַטְיָא a. אִסְרַטְיָא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Ex. R.s. 36, leia-se: סְטַרְטְיוֹטִין ou סְרַטְיוֹטִין.
notas_originais: , Ex. R. s. 36, read: סְטַרְטְיוֹטִין or סְרַטְיוֹטִין.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (τριτημόριον, S.) triens, um terço de um as, uma moeda e um peso (cerca de três onças).
definicoes_originais: (τριτημόριον, S.) triens, one third of an as, a coin and a weight (about three ounces).
notas_originais: Snh. VIII, 2 ט' בשר (Bab. ed. 70 a ת'; Ms. F. ט', in Gemarah טרדימר; Y. Mish. טרת', Gemarah 26 a טרט') a triens (worth?) of meat. Ib. 70 a (ת') ט' זה וכ' I do not know what this ṭ ar ṭ emar means, but judging from R. José doubling the standard for wine, it may be inferred that ṭ. is half a Manah; Y. l. c. ט' חצי ליטרא ṭ. is half a Litra. (V. Zuckerm. Talm. Münzen p. 8).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (denominação de טוּרְטִינִי) equilibrar, ou seja, andar com um pé de cada lado do animal.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of טוּרְטִינִי) to balance, i.e. to ride with one foot on each side of the animal.
notas_originais: Nidd. 14 a דמְטַרְטֵין when he rides like a man on horseback, דלא מט' when he rides like a woman.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Sifré Num. 86 לשאר הט', leia הֶדְיוֹטִין, v. Núm. 732, fim.
notas_originais: , Sifré Num. 86 לשאר הט', read הֶדְיוֹטִין, v. Yalk. Num. 732, end.
ṭ ar ṭ ur in Dozy Dict. des noms des vêtem., p. 262 sq., Lat. turritum capitis ornamentum &c.) t’ratin, a head cover. Kel. XXIX, 1; Tosef. ib. B. Bath. VII, 5 טְרָטוֹן ed. Zuck. (Var. טרסי).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Ko. R. a VII, 11 ואתי מן ט' ואמר ליה טליא (alterado em eds posteriores. טרסיס) uma passagem corrompida a ser restaurada por comparação com Y. Ber. III, 6 c bot.; talvez: ואתי חד טליא ואמר ליה.
notas_originais: , Koh. R. to VII, 11 ואתי מן ט' ואמר ליה טליא (emended in later eds. טרסיס) a corrupt passage to be restored by collation with Y. Ber. III, 6 c bot.; perhaps: ואתי חד טליא ואמר ליה.
, v. טַרְטְיָאוֹת

verbetes.glosa_atual: (reduplica. de טרף) para cortar bordas, para rosa.
definicoes_originais: (reduplic. of טרף) to cut out edges, to pink.
notas_originais: scallop (a leather garment). Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 1 משיְטַרְטֵף ed. Vien. (ed. Zuck. a. oth. משישטרטף, ed. Zolk. משישוטף) (cmp. Kel. XVI, 4 משיחסום וכ' &c.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (transposição de craticulum, v. P. Sm. 1516) [rede, esp.] uma pequena grelha.
definicoes_originais: (transpos. of craticulum, v. P. Sm. 1516) [ net-work, esp.] a small gridiron.

verbetes.glosa_atual: [para colocar em movimento,]; tremer.; lançar, lançar; esguichar, pingar.; Transf. שקיל וטרי [pegar e jogar uma bola para trás, etc.,] ouvir e responder, discutir; negociar (correspondente a h. נשא ונתן).
definicoes_originais: to throw, cast; to squirt, drip.
Trnsf. שקיל וטרי [ to take up and throw back a ball &c.,] to hear and reply, to argue; to negotiate (corresp. to h. נשא ונתן).
notas_originais: Ḥull. 45 b טַרְיֵיה לרישיה shook his head constantly; [Ar.: he bumped his head, shocked his brain]. Ib. 51 a, v. טְרַח II.

Tam. 32 b ט' באפיה sprinkled his face (with that water). Sabb. 108 b מהו למִטְרָא וכ' Ar. (ed. למימשי, Ms. O. למישרא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) is it permitted to drop some of this water into the eye?—Lev. R. s. 25 יהי טָרֵי וכ' (not טרו) shall cast one fig in his face; Koh. R. to II, 20 יהא טריה (read: יהא טרי חד). Taan. 24 a bot. טַרְיוּהוּ מן גודא וכ' Ms. M. 2 (ed. חבוטו) throw him down from the elevation; a. fr.

Targ. Ruth IV, 7. Targ. Cant. III, 8 יטַרְיָן (not וטירן; ed. Lag. וטָארָן).—B. Mets. 64 a דלא ש' וט' בהדיה with whom he was not accustomed to deal. Sot. 7 b למישקל ולמִיטְרָא וכ' Ar. (ed. ומטרח, corr. acc.) to argue with &c.; a. fr.—V. טָרוּן.
f., v. טָרִיתָא
, pr. n., v. טָדִי
—[In later literature שקלא וטַרְיָא argument, v. טְרִי.]

definicoes_originais: (טְרִי) dripping; מֵי ט' a sort of ink, prob. from wine-lees (v. Löw Graph. Requisiten, p. 158, p. 161).

Naz. l. c.; Y. ib. I, 51 b top; Tosef. ib. I, 2 דרגון ed. Zuck. (Var. דיגון, corr. acc.); v. דִּיגוֹן.
p. 22, v. טוֹגָא.—Ib. p. 23 מכסה כמין ט', prob. to be read: טְרִיבוֹן (τρίβων) coarse cloak

verbetes.glosa_atual: (טָרַף); rasgando (por bestas de rapina).; sendo levado pelas ondas, sendo lançado em terra.; (denominação de טֶרֶף) cobertura com folhas, cobertura noturna ao ar livre.
definicoes_originais: being carried away by waves, being cast ashore.
(denom. of טֶרֶף) covering with leaves, night cover in open air.
notas_originais: B. Kam. 16 b למימרא דט' לאו וכ' (some ed. דטריפא, Ms. M. דטָרַף, ref. to the preceding טרף ואכל) does that mean to say that tearing is not his (the lion’s) habit?
Y. Yeb. XVI, 15 d top נותנין … כדי ט' the court allows a reasonable time sufficient for the discovery of an eventual escape of the husband by being cast ashore.
Yalk. Gen. 119, v. רְטִיבָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: um animal dilacerado por uma fera predadora.; (lei ritual) um animal afetado por uma doença orgânica (fatal), cuja descoberta, após o abate, o torna proibido, t’refah, (de pessoas, m.) alguém que tenha uma doença orgânica fatal (cuja morte não seria considerada assassinato perante a lei).; doença orgânica.
definicoes_originais: an animal torn by a beast of prey.

(ritual law) an animal afflicted with a ( fatal) organic disease, the discovery of which, after slaughtering, makes it forbidden, t’refah, (of persons, m.) one having a fatal organic disease (the killing of whom would not be considered murder before the law).
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, v. טֶרֶף.

Ḥull. 42 a ט' אינה חיה a t’refa animal cannot survive (a year); a. fr.—Snh. 78 a ההורג את הט' if one kills a person afflicted with a fatal organic disease; וט' שהרג and if such a person committed a murder. Ib. עידי ט' witnesses afflicted &c.; a. fr.

Lev. R. s. 13 (ref. to החיה, Lev. XI, 2) החיה מטְרֵיפָתָהּ וכ' that which can recover from its disease, you may eat.— Pl. טְרֵיפוֹת, טְרֵפוֹת. Ḥull. III, 1; a. fr.—Esp. cases of t’refah, ritual law concerning t’refah. Ib. 48 b; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: (denom. of Tripolis) Tripolitans, residents of Tripolis on the Phoenician coast.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. II Gen. X, 17 (h. text חוי).
